_comment: The SSRF guard's cases, as data, because there are two implementations of
it: src/utils/urlGuard.ts for the extension and
jot/Sources/BirtaJotCore/UrlGuard.swift for the Jot shell. Neither language
can import the other, and a second implementation of a security check that
nothing compares against is the kind of duplication that drifts silently
and is discovered by an incident.
So the cases live here and both test suites read this file:
ran, so an unreadable or empty fixture fails rather than passing quietly.
Add a case here, not in one suite. A case that only one implementation can
pass is the finding, not the fixture's problem.
